about.heading: Manchester concrete contractors who show up
about.body: We're the concrete team Manchester calls when the job needs to be done right. Real trucks, experienced crew, and we answer our phone.

reviews.name: Olivia A.
reviews.text: Hard to put into words how much respect I have for Sheane and the Eldridge Concrete crew. Our cottage patio was a disaster — sunken, cracked, causing foundation damage. They fixed it all.

reviews.name: Ana S.
reviews.text: Amazing job on my stamped concrete walkway! They worked with me on exact colors, were super responsive, explained everything. Stuck to timeline even with weather delays.

reviews.name: Meredith L.
reviews.text: Sheane was professional, responsive, and knowledgeable about his craft. Most cost effective quote of the four I got. Did my homework — glad I chose Eldridge.
